description: This file implements a Price Alert Service for a shopping application, managing subscriptions, detecting price drops or discount increases, persisting data in localStorage, and providing backend fallback mechanisms.

methods.name: subscribe
methods.description: Subscribe to price/discount alerts for a product, updating local storage and attempting backend subscription.

methods.name: unsubscribe
methods.description: Unsubscribe from alerts for a product, updating local storage and attempting backend unsubscription.

methods.name: isSubscribed
methods.description: Check if the current user is subscribed to price alerts for a specific product.

methods.name: checkForPriceDrops
methods.description: Check current products against last seen prices/discounts to detect drops or increases, notify user, and update last seen data.

methods.name: notifyPriceDrop
methods.description: Notify user of a detected price drop or discount increase via callback or console fallback.

methods.name: setAlertPreferences
methods.description: Set per-product alert preferences for price drops and discount increases.

methods.name: getAlertPreferences
methods.description: Retrieve per-product alert preferences, with defaults.
